scope: One fresh anonymous desktop context. Public /en home and /en/models only, public manifest assets, and any naturally occurring exact anonymous GET /api/user/me 401. No auth click, personal profile, cookie/storage import, credential, HAR, source mutation, request interception, cache override, CSP bypass, synthetic lifecycle event or extra BFCache feature flag.

methodology.navigation: Page.navigate once, then real CDP mouse input to the public models link, then Page.getNavigationHistory/Page.navigateToHistoryEntry for back and forward. All DOM observations/screenshot use direct CDP, never Playwright Page navigation, locator or evaluate.
methodology.persistedProof: A genuine trusted pageshow with persisted=true, same per-Document token, actual retained Document/window sentinel/root/h1/useId nodes and nonce, CDP BackForwardCacheRestore, and no replacement Document HTTP request are all required.
methodology.notRestored: A normal history reload with persisted=false and a new Document is NOT_RESTORED, even if fallback display is correct. Null notRestoredReasons is never treated as BFCache proof.

configuration.browserTransport: Public chromium.launchServer on 127.0.0.1 port0, then public chromium.connect

priorCondition.explanation: Installed Chrome auto-updated before the previous actual run; V3 pins current .98 using executable SHA/bytes/PE FileVersion and actual Browser.getVersion. It does not claim BFCache under the old .95 condition, or claim the update caused the previous metadata API failure.
